status.description: implemented: the approved plan is in the working tree and the checks pass. blocked: you stopped; explain why in summary.

summary.description: What you changed and why, for the pull request description (or why you are blocked).

changes.description: One entry per file you changed.

followUps.description: Anything deliberately left out of this change.

commit.description: The Conventional Commits header for the commit and the pull request title: type(scope)!: summary.

type.description: feat: new capability. fix: bug fix. refactor: no behaviour change. perf: performance. test: tests only. docs: docs only. ci: CI workflows. chore: maintenance and tooling.

scope.description: The area changed, lowercase, for example api, android, db, infra, tasks.

summary.description: Short imperative summary, lowercase start, no trailing period, for example add optional due dates to tasks.

breaking.description: True when the change breaks existing callers, data or behaviour (adds ! to the header).

breakingChange.description: When breaking: what breaks and what to do about it (the BREAKING CHANGE footer). Empty otherwise.
